title: filedom example manifest
description: examples/<fw>/filedom-example.json: what the docs and playground show for one framework.

framework.description: Must equal the example directory name.

logo.description: SVG file relative to the example directory.

install.description: Shell command that installs the packages, shown verbatim.

files.description: Integration files shown as code tabs, in order. Exactly one has role page.

path.description: Relative to the example directory. A missing file fails the docs build.

label.description: Tab title. Defaults to the file name.

language.description: Prism language. Defaults from the extension.
